It holds every turn after the task, one block per turn, each starting with a header line such as `<<< turn 7 assistant >>>`. The system prompt and the task are pinned and are not in the file. You can edit the file with patch or write_file to drop turns you no longer need, or to replace long tool output with a short note of what mattered. After each round of tool calls your edits become the conversation. Keep headers as they are on turns you leave untouched: an untouched turn keeps its tool calls, and a changed one becomes plain text. Read the file before you rewrite it with write_file: turns you have not read in it are kept. Before an edit is applied, the file as it was is saved at /ctx/20261006_101500_ab12cd/context.prev.txt, so you can copy back turns you dropped by mistake. Once a round is over, your edits to the file are kept only as their lengths, and a read of the file only as its length. The context has a budget of 4,000 tokens. The budget limits how much of the conversation is kept, not how much work you can do: when it fills, compact the file and carry on with the task. Each tool result ends with a context line showing how much is used. If the budget is exceeded, your newest turns are dropped and you are asked to compact the file. Turns that only edit the context file do not count towards your step limit. Read and edit the context file with read_file, patch and write_file, not through the terminal.

It holds every turn after the task, one block per turn, each starting with a header line such as `<<< turn 7 assistant >>>`. The system prompt and the task are pinned and are not in the file. You can edit the file with patch or write_file to drop turns you no longer need, or to replace long tool output with a short note of what mattered. After each round of tool calls your edits become the conversation. Keep headers as they are on turns you leave untouched: an untouched turn keeps its tool calls, and a changed one becomes plain text. Read the file before you rewrite it with write_file: turns you have not read in it are kept. Before an edit is applied, the file as it was is saved at /ctx/20261006_101500_ab12cd/context.prev.txt, so you can copy back turns you dropped by mistake. Once a round is over, your edits to the file are kept only as their lengths, and a read of the file only as its length. The context has a budget of 1,000 tokens. The budget limits how much of the conversation is kept, not how much work you can do: when it fills, compact the file and carry on with the task. Each tool result ends with a context line showing how much is used. If the budget is exceeded, your newest turns are dropped and you are asked to compact the file. Turns that only edit the context file do not count towards your step limit. Read and edit the context file with read_file, patch and write_file, not through the terminal.
